glosses.notes: As a noun, 盖 is a lid or cover. As a verb, it means covering something, including covering food or pulling a blanket over yourself.

examples.sentence: 杯子的盖掉了，水都流出来了。
晚上冷，记得把被子盖好。
先把菜盖上，等客人来了再吃。

example_translations.translation: The lid of the cup fell off, and the water all spilled out.
It is cold at night, so remember to cover yourself with the blanket.
Cover the dishes first, and we'll eat when the guests arrive.

glosses.notes: As a verb, it means to sum up the main points. As an adjective, it describes something that is only general or brief and not detailed enough.

examples.sentence: 请你先概括一下这篇文章的主要意思。
他用三句话概括了这次会议的重点。
你的介绍太概括了，我还是没听懂。

example_translations.translation: Please first summarize the main meaning of this article.
He summed up the key points of this meeting in three sentences.
Your introduction was too general, so I still did not understand it.

glosses.notes: An abstract idea or basic notion that helps explain or organize knowledge.

examples.sentence: 老师先讲清楚什么是基本概念。
我对这个新概念还有点不明白。
时间和速度不是同一个概念。

example_translations.translation: The teacher first explained clearly what a basic concept is.
I still do not fully understand this new concept.
Time and speed are not the same concept.

glosses.notes: Used for having the courage to do something difficult, risky, or honest.

examples.sentence: 他敢于在会上说出真话。
年轻人要敢于尝试新方法。
她敢于承认自己的错误。

example_translations.translation: He dares to speak the truth at meetings.
Young people should dare to try new methods.
She dares to admit her own mistakes.

glosses.notes: Used when something fits perfectly, is exactly the right amount, or happens at just that moment.

examples.sentence: 这双鞋我穿着刚好，不大也不小。
我到车站的时候，车刚好开走。
这张桌子刚好放得下四个人。

example_translations.translation: These shoes fit me just right, not too big and not too small.
When I got to the station, the train happened to be leaving.
This table is just big enough for four people.

glosses.notes: Describes a person, tree, building, or other thing that is tall and gives a strong, imposing impression.

examples.sentence: 他长得很高大，别人一下就看到他。
院子里有一棵高大的老树。
远远看去，那座楼显得特别高大。

example_translations.translation: He is so tall and big that people notice him right away.
There is a tall old tree in the yard.
From a distance, that building looks especially tall and imposing.

glosses.notes: Describes goods, places, or styles that are expensive, refined, or aimed at a higher market level.

examples.sentence: 这家店主要卖高档家具和灯。
这家酒店虽然不大，但是很高档。
这种车看起来很高档，但是不便宜。

example_translations.translation: This shop mainly sells high-end furniture and lamps.
Although this hotel is not big, it is very upscale.
This kind of car looks very high-end, but it is not cheap.

glosses.notes: Most often it means physical height. In formal expressions like 高度重视, it also means doing something to a very high degree.

examples.sentence: 从这个高度往下看，人都很小。
医生量了孩子的高度和体重。
学校高度重视学生安全问题。

example_translations.translation: From this height, people look very small.
The doctor measured the child's height and weight.
The school places great importance on student safety.

glosses.notes: Used for advanced courses and levels, and also for senior positions or high-ranking roles.

examples.sentence: 她现在上的是高级汉语课。
公司请来了一位高级工程师。
完成前面的训练后，才可以进高级班。

example_translations.translation: She is now taking an advanced Chinese class.
The company brought in a senior engineer.
Only after finishing the earlier training can you enter the advanced class.

glosses.notes: Refers to advanced technology, high-tech products, or the high-tech sector more generally.

examples.sentence: 这家公司主要做高科技产品。
现在医院里也用了不少高科技。
很多年轻人都想去高科技公司工作。

example_translations.translation: This company mainly makes high-tech products.
Now hospitals also use quite a lot of high technology.
Many young people want to work for high-tech companies.

glosses.notes: Describes methods, teams, or systems that work quickly and effectively with little wasted time or effort.

examples.sentence: 这套办法很高效，半天就做完了。
提前准备好材料，开会会更高效。
一个高效的团队离不开合作。

example_translations.translation: This method is very efficient and got the work done in half a day.
If the materials are prepared in advance, the meeting will be more efficient.
An efficient team cannot do without cooperation.

glosses.notes: A broad colloquial verb. It often means handling or doing something, organizing something, or figuring something out in compounds like 搞清楚.

examples.sentence: 他们想一起搞一个小活动。
这件事太复杂，我一个人搞不定。
你先把时间搞清楚，再告诉我。

example_translations.translation: They want to organize a small activity together.
This matter is too complicated for me to handle alone.
Figure out the timing first, and then tell me.

glosses.notes: Used both for saying goodbye to people and for parting with a place, period of life, or earlier stage.

examples.sentence: 大家在车站跟他告别。
毕业那天，我们告别了学生生活。
下个月他就要告别北京了。

example_translations.translation: Everyone said goodbye to him at the station.
On graduation day, we said goodbye to student life.
He will be leaving Beijing next month.

glosses.notes: The words of a song, whether spoken of on paper, on screen, or in memory.

examples.sentence: 这首歌的歌词写得特别好。
我只记得前面两句歌词。
她一看到歌词就跟着唱了起来。

example_translations.translation: The lyrics of this song are especially well written.
I only remember the first two lines of the lyrics.
As soon as she saw the lyrics, she started singing along.

glosses.notes: A song or musical piece with words and melody. Compared with 歌, 歌曲 often sounds a little more formal.

examples.sentence: 这首歌曲是他大学时写的。
比赛前，每个人要准备两首歌曲。
我小时候常听这位歌手的歌曲。

example_translations.translation: This song was written by him when he was in college.
Before the competition, each person needs to prepare two songs.
I often listened to this singer's songs when I was little.

glosses.notes: Used when two places or people are separated by something, and also in time expressions for an interval between occasions.

examples.sentence: 我家和学校只隔一条街。
两个人隔着门说了很久。
我们隔一天开一次会。

example_translations.translation: My home and the school are only one street apart.
The two people talked for a long time with the door between them.
We have a meeting every other day.

glosses.notes: Used to add emphasis when something feels more noticeable than usual.

examples.sentence: 今天的海边格外安静。
听到这个消息，她格外高兴。
天气冷的时候，他格外想家。

example_translations.translation: The seaside is especially quiet today.
When she heard this news, she was particularly happy.
When the weather turns cold, he misses home especially strongly.

glosses.notes: Refers to only a very small number of people, things, or cases, or to isolated individual cases rather than the whole group.

examples.sentence: 个别同学还没交作业。
报告里个别地方还要再改。
个别人对这个决定有意见。

example_translations.translation: A few students still have not handed in their homework.
A few individual parts of the report still need to be revised.
A few individuals have objections to this decision.

glosses.notes: An idiomatic noun phrase for many different occupations and fields across society.

examples.sentence: 网络已经影响到各行各业。
这次活动请来了各行各业的人。
各行各业都需要会用电脑的人。

example_translations.translation: The internet has already affected all walks of life.
This event invited people from all walks of life.
Every trade and profession needs people who can use computers.

glosses.notes: Depending on position, 个人 can mean personal, an individual person, or personally from one's own point of view.

examples.sentence: 这只是我个人的看法。
这个奖是发给个人，不是发给集体。
我个人还是更喜欢早上开会。

example_translations.translation: This is only my personal view.
This award is given to individuals, not to groups.
Personally, I still prefer having meetings in the morning.

glosses.notes: A person's character and temperament, or the distinctive character that makes someone or something stand out.

examples.sentence: 她的个性很好，不太爱生气。
这家小店的设计很有个性。
两个人个性不同，相处方式也不一样。

example_translations.translation: She has a good personality and does not get angry easily.
The design of this little shop has a lot of individuality.
The two people have different personalities, so the way they get along is different too.

glosses.notes: Refers to each person or side separately, often when people return to, choose, or think about their own things.

examples.sentence: 大家回到各自的位置上吧。
下课以后，他们各自回家了。
两个人都有各自的想法。

example_translations.translation: Everyone, go back to your own places.
After class, they each went home.
The two people each have their own ideas.

secondary_glosses: measure word for long, thin things
glosses.notes: As a noun, it means the root of a plant. As a measure word, it is used for long, thin things like ropes, bananas, needles, or hair.

examples.sentence: 这棵树的根很深，不怕大风。

examples.meaning_en: measure word for long, thin things
examples.sentence: 我衣服上有一根头发。

examples.meaning_en: measure word for long, thin things
examples.sentence: 她刚才掉了一根头发。

example_translations.translation: The roots of this tree run deep, so it is not afraid of strong wind.
There is a strand of hair on my clothes.
She just lost a strand of hair.

glosses.notes: As a noun or adjective, it refers to the root or most basic part of something. As an adverb, often in negative sentences, it means simply or not at all.

examples.sentence: 这是根本问题，要先解决。
我们终于找到了失败的根本原因。
他根本没明白我的意思。

example_translations.translation: This is a fundamental problem and needs to be solved first.
We finally found the root cause of the failure.
He did not understand what I meant at all.

glosses.notes: Used when one thing is taken out and another is put in its place, such as a battery, a part, or a medicine.

examples.sentence: 这台机器的电池该更换了。
医生建议她更换一种药。
公司已经把旧系统更换成新的了。

example_translations.translation: The battery in this machine should be replaced.
The doctor suggested that she switch to a different medicine.
The company has already replaced the old system with a new one.

glosses.notes: Used for making information, software, systems, or lists newer and more current.

examples.sentence: 网站的内容每天都会更新。
系统更新以后，手机更好用了。
这份名单还没有更新到最新。

example_translations.translation: The content on the website is updated every day.
After the system was updated, the phone became easier to use.
This list still has not been updated to the latest version.

glosses.notes: Used when results, decisions, plans, or news are officially made known to the public.

examples.sentence: 学校明天公布考试结果。
名单一公布，大家就去看了。
这项计划还没有正式公布。

example_translations.translation: The school will announce the exam results tomorrow.
As soon as the list was made public, everyone went to look at it.
This plan still has not been officially announced.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to a construction or technical project that takes planning, money, and organized work.

examples.sentence: 这个工程要明年才做完。
爸爸最近一直在别的地方做工程。
这项工程花了很多时间和钱。

example_translations.translation: This project will not be finished until next year.
Dad has been working on engineering projects in another place lately.
This project cost a great deal of time and money.

glosses.notes: A trained engineer, especially someone who designs, builds, or solves technical problems.

examples.sentence: 她爸爸是一名工程师。
这位工程师很会解决问题。
公司新来了几位年轻工程师。

example_translations.translation: Her father is an engineer.
This engineer is very good at solving problems.
Several young engineers have just joined the company.

glosses.notes: A tool used for doing a task, and by extension something useful as a practical means for learning or work.

examples.sentence: 这些工具用完以后要放回去。
没有合适的工具，很难修好它。
手机现在也是学习工具之一。

example_translations.translation: These tools need to be put back after use.
Without the right tools, it is hard to fix it properly.
Phones are now also one of the tools people use for learning.
